subject: Intro demo + a few quick qualification items
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@fintrax.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo + a few quick qualification items

Hi Nora —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference and for experimenting with the API — I’m Soojin on the SDR team and I can set up a short demo to show the best way to integrate based on your use case. Before we lock time, two quick things so Rafael (AE) can tailor the session: 

1) Primary use case: is this for customer support automation, search/semantic retrieval, or batch embedding pipelines? A 1-2 sentence summary is perfect.
2) Expected volume: ballpark monthly tokens or number of inference calls (e.g., 5M tokens / 100k requests) and peak concurrency (if known).
3) Timeline: aiming for POC or production? Any deadlines (e.g., launch Q1/Q2)?
4) Data sensitivity: will requests include PCI/PII or customer secrets that need special handling?

Proposed times (PDT) — feel free to send alternatives if none of these work: 
- Thu Oct 16, 10:00–10:30am
- Thu Oct 16, 2:00–2:30pm
- Fri Oct 17, 11:00–11:30am

Typical demo is 30 minutes (overview + 10–15 min for your scenario + Q&A). I attached a one-pager that summarizes our offering. If you prefer, I can loop in Rafael (AE) or an engineer from our side — who from your team should join?

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
cal: https://calendar.google.com/calendar/selfserve/soojin
Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (one-page product overview)
From: Nora Patel <nora@fintrax.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro demo + a few quick qualification items

Hi Soojin — thanks for the quick note and for the one-pager. Quick answers below: 

1) Use case: primarily customer support augmentation — routing + short answer generation for transactional payment issues (order lookups, dispute guidance).
2) Volume: currently ~50k user-facing interactions/month; we expect to double by Q2. Average request size ~400 tokens; we care about latency under 300ms for live flows.
3) Timeline: POC in November, aim for pilot in January.
4) Data sensitivity: contains masked payment references and customer emails — not full card numbers. We’ll likely need to discuss data handling / SOC2 evidence.

People: please include Rafael (sales) and Samir (our lead platform engineer) — Samir copied.

For times — the Thu 2:00pm PDT slot works best on our side (that’s 5:00pm ET). Can you send an invite?

Best,
Nora
Head of Product
Fintrax Payments
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@fintrax.com>, Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@fintrax.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro demo + a few quick qualification items

Thanks Nora — great context, that helps a lot. I’ve created a 30-minute demo for Thu Oct 16 at 2:00pm PDT / 5:00pm EDT and sent a calendar invite (link below). Rafael will lead the product conversation and I’ll cover integration patterns and performance (latency/cost).

Agenda (30 min):
- 5 min: intros & goals
- 10 min: demo focused on low-latency support flows (retrieval + generation)
- 10 min: integration patterns for batching/kv-cache and cost options
- 5 min: next steps / POC checklist (SOC2 evidence, test data)

Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz123_demo
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FB-2025-0897
Attachments: demo-checklist.docx (short list of items we’ll ask for during POC)

If Samir wants a deeper technical follow-up (50–60 min) we can schedule a separate session; otherwise Rafael can coordinate the POC kickoff after the demo.

See you Thursday —
Soojin
From: Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@fintrax.com>
